metadata.pass_rule: main_correct == 1 and all four material-error flags == 0
metadata.review_method: Visual inspection of all 200 photos and both captions; enlarged images consulted for selected ambiguous details.
metadata.blinding_limit: A/B identities were omitted from the supplied package. Some examples and method identities were already discussed earlier, so this is not a fully independent blind review.
metadata.human_review_status: All 200 image pairs confirmed by the author; human_review.pairs contains the final ratings.

metadata_correction.reason: Correct stale draft-only reviewer/status metadata; no ratings or proposals changed.
